component.name: USB Flash Memory Toolset
component.summary: Analyze, test, wipe and reset USB flash drives

description.p: Find out what is on old USB sticks and how healthy they are, wipe them for privacy, and return them to a clean factory state with one click.

ul.li: Recognizes about 30 filesystems and encrypted containers
Health check and detection of counterfeit capacity
Verified wiping with honest failure reports
Factory reset with FAT32 or exFAT
Backup to an image file, tolerating read errors
